frame.stacking: not stackable: a stepped ground store whose arrows stand above the frame (to ~1.9 m).

space.unity: prefab space, origin on the floor at the centre of the footprint, +z front, +y up, +x to the furniture's left seen from the front

groups.0-6: front row (lowest step), left to right seen from the front: ordinary arrows; tube 6 is a spare
groups.7-12: middle row: fire, surtling fire, poison, frost, silver, needle
groups.13-19: back row (highest step): carapace, chitin, charred, green metal, ancient; tubes 18 and 19 are spares
groups.rule: one arrow kind per tube (unit 'item' = the kind; the 3 spare tubes have no item and take any other arrow in a ByGroup store). Units are listed tube by tube, 4 per tube, in fill order.

band_spare: hemp rope (unpainted) on the 3 spare tubes
fill_order: Four units per tube, 13 copies per unit, deterministically shuffled across the tube footprint for balanced partial fills.
position: Unit position is the tube floor centre. Ammo offset.y is 0; current StoreModel.Place discards that component and bottom-anchors the aligned item bounds.
copy_rule: Each of the 20 tubes has a separately seeded, mesh-aware best-candidate layout of 52 arrows. Four balanced fill stages of 13 copies. Independent planar positions, shaft spins and small outward leans; no copied or rotated tube template. Existing 0.86 m fitted length retained.
straw: Unmodified r3 closed beds, 15-25 mm under the stave rim. Arrows pass through straw; it is never a support.

heads.rule: Current game source Ammo.HeadOf projectile axis; fallback HeadDown set for the four reversed vanilla arrows. Offline previews additionally infer the reversed tip of Needle/Bone/Ancient from the rigid rip. No game integration or live projectile check is performed.

items.arrow_size: Unchanged from approved r3: fit_longest_m (longest_m) 0.86. No additional shrink. This is an inherited fitted display length, not native dropped-item scale.

not_checked.live_projectile_directions: No running game in this handoff. Vanilla fallback plus rigid-rip sign used for previews.
not_checked.mod_item_bounds: Five mod arrows use rip bounds; live enabled-renderer ItemVisual bounds are unavailable.

layout.layouts: 20 independently seeded arrangements; no shared cone template
layout.density: 52 copies per tube retained. Actual measured collision results are in checks and logs; no collision-free claim is inferred from the export gate.

checks.method: Separate exported-anchor readback in audit_r4.py using current source-derived ammo placement. Triangle BVH with alpha-mask subdivision (8 subdivisions, one-texel conservative mask dilation); nonrigid feather_chunk / arrow_needle_feathers quad sprites excluded from rigid collisions, retained in renders and raw-extent checks. Above-straw counts clip triangles at 0.403 m over the floor. OBJ X is flipped exactly as ObjMesh.Load(flipX:true).
limitations: No live game or projectile direction lookup. The supplied runtime fallback and static rigid-tip inference drive previews.
Five mod arrows use root-space rip bounds; enabled-renderer ItemVisual bounds were not provided.
Decorative feather quads can extend outside the rigid cavity. Raw extent results remain reported.
This is a static geometry audit, not a physics or mechanical-stability simulation.

r4_validation.unmet: Zero intersections at the required fullness. See checks.summary and READY.md.
